Company Journey

Akshar Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd. (Formerly known as Akshar Consultancy Services) is a professional third-party inspection services and project support organization delivering quality-focused technical solutions across various industries to achieve the best quality with impartiality, integrity, ethics, health, safety & environment by delivering efficient, trustworthy, and client-centric services.
Our multidisciplinary engineers safeguard capital investments through rigid adherence to statutory codes (ASME, API, AWS, ISO/EN) and approved quality assurance plans (QAP/ITP).
Our Vision
To become a trusted and recognized third-party inspection & project engineering service organization by delivering reliable inspection, robust quality assurance, and ethical engineering solutions.
Core Services
Comprehensive surveillance, expediting, auditing, and NDT engineering interventions for mission-critical industrial assets.

Third Party Inspection
              
              
                
                  Rigid technical surveillance ensuring complete conformance with client QAP, approved ITPs, and statutory international codes.

Exhaustive shop-floor capability verification protecting capital buyers against unproven fabricators and supply delays.

QA/QC Documentation
Flawless technical record governance ensuring zero documentation hold-ups for plant commissioning and handover.
Equipment & Asset Scope
Disciplines and asset classes audited by our certified field surveyors across fabrication shops and raw material mills.
Basic Material
Verification at steel mills, foundries, and stockyards covering plates, seamless and welded pipes, forged flanges, fittings, and castings.
Fabricated Structures
Surveillance at structural yards and piping shops covering process piping spools, heavy steel structures, modular skids, and manifolds.
Static Equipment
Critical path inspection for pressure vessels, shell & tube heat exchangers, storage tanks, columns, and industrial boilers.
Rotary Machinery
Performance run auditing and factory acceptance testing for centrifugal pumps, gas compressors, industrial turbines, and gearboxes.
Sectors We Serve
Dedicated quality assurance personnel deployed across capital-intensive engineering domains.
Oil & Gas
Upstream manifolds, offshore drilling platforms, subsea pipelines, and sour service gas processing facilities.
Refinery & Petrochemical
Cracking towers, catalytic reforming vessels, hydrotreaters, and high-capacity storage tank farms.
Power Plants
Supercritical thermal boilers, combined cycle heat recovery steam generators (HRSG), and turbine halls.
Renewable Energy
Utility-scale solar module testing, tracker foundations, wind turbine tower weldments, and green hydrogen skids.
Civil Construction
Major highway bridge viaducts, metro rail frameworks, precast girder alignments, and heavy structural assemblies.
Heavy Fabrication
OEM machinery manufacturing, heavy crane structures, mining equipment frames, and critical material handling assemblies.
Trusted By
Empaneled and approved third-party technical inspection partner for premier EPC contractors and project developers.
Request an Inspection
Reach out to our technical dispatch desk for immediate surveyor allocation, quality plan reviews, or project RFQ inquiries.
